headline: 'Technology ecosystem' changes import structure, Thailand's trade deficit reaches 1.1 trillion baht in H1 2569
summary: Thailand's first-half exports reached 6.2 trillion baht, up 17.6%, while imports reached 7.3 trillion baht, up 38.0%. The trade deficit widened to 1.1 trillion baht.
why: Trade balances reflect a country's external position, which influences its currency and investor confidence in its economy.
